Composting Program

Scripps College has partnered with Integrative Development Initiative (IDI) to support our composting efforts. IDI is a nonprofit organization focused on building healthy, equitable, and sustainable communities through access to resources, services, and education.
Food scraps collected from Scripps College are diverted from landfill and turned into compost, helping give these materials a new purpose while supporting a more sustainable local food system.

Learn More About IDI

Menu Icon Legend

Vegetarian: Contains no meat, fish, poultry, shellfish or products derived from these sources but may contain dairy or eggs.
Vegan: Contains absolutely no animal or dairy products.
Made without Gluten-Containing Ingredients: does not contain ingredients that are sources of gluten, but is prepared in an open kitchen where gluten is present.
Seafood Watch: Contains seafood that meets the Monterey Bay Aquarium's Seafood Watch guidelines for commercial buyers.
Organic: Contains at least 95 percent organically produced ingredients (by weight) from a USDA certified source
Humane: Contains humanely raised meat, poultry, or eggs. Must be certified by a credible third-party animal welfare organization.
Tree Nuts: May contain tree nuts. All menu items are prepared in an open kitchen that handles all major allergens.
Sesame: May contain sesame. All menu items are prepared in open kitchens that handle all major allergens.
Fish: May contain fish. All menu items are prepared in an open kitchen that handles all major allergens.
Wheat/Gluten: May contain wheat/gluten. Our kitchens are not certified gluten-free so risk of cross-contact is present.
Milk: May contain milk. All menu items are prepared in an open kitchen that handles all major allergens.
Egg: May contain egg. All menu items are prepared in an open kitchen that handles all major allergens.
Soy: May contain soy. All menu items are prepared in an open kitchen that handles all major allergens.
Information Unavailable: Speak to a manager or chef for assistance.

FOOD ALLERGEN WARNING

Ingredient and allergen information is provided for informational purposes in response to guest requests. Products may change without our knowledge and menu items are prepared in close proximity to other ingredients that may introduce cross-contact with ingredients and/or allergens not listed. We cannot assure against these contingencies. Guests with food allergies or specific dietary concerns should speak with a manager for individualized assistance.

FOOD ALLERGIES

SERVING STUDENTS WITH FOOD ALLERGIES AND CELIAC DISEASE

The dining services team is well-trained in food allergy awareness and offer a number of options for students with food allergies. Top-9 allergens are each identified with a designated icon which can be found on signage throughout the café. The full list of ingredients and allergens is available online at scripps.cafebonappetit.com.

Have questions? Please reach out!

Please be aware that Bon Appétit handles all top-9 allergens as well as other potential allergens in an open kitchen environment. Products, ingredients, and recipes may change without our knowledge or come into contact with other allergens. We cannot assure against this possibility. Guests with food allergies should speak to a manager or ask for assistance with food choices.

RESOURCES

For more on eating with a food allergy in our café, visit this page and view the guide on managing dietary needs at Scripps College below.

Food Recovery Verified

Scripps College is fighting food waste and hunger by recovering surplus perishable food from our campus that would otherwise go to waste and donating it to people in need through Vesta Foodservice.

Meet the team

Eat Right — For You

Wellness

We serve thousands of guests with food allergies and sensitivities safely in our cafés every day. Our chefs, managers, and dietitians work closely with our food-allergic guests to create reasonable solutions to help them eat what they love. If you have questions about eating for your dietary needs in our cafés, reach out to us: we’ll gladly meet with you.

Our wellness commitments

Food Allergies

We serve thousands of guests with food allergies and sensitivities safely in our cafés every day. Our chefs, managers, and dietitians work closely with our food-allergic guests to create reasonable solutions to help them eat what they love. If you have questions about eating for your dietary needs in our cafés, reach out to us: we’ll gladly meet with you.

Food allergies & sensitivities

Sustainability

Wellness also includes the health of the animals, the workers, the community, and the Earth. They’re all connected. Bon Appétit has been committed to “food service for a sustainable future” for decades, and we’ve led the food service industry in tackling many important issues, such as cage-free eggs, antibiotics in animal production, and farmworker rights.
